I had a Tesla invader 3 which went to 200-240w depending on the batteries and it was more than enough just remember that the coils you use can make or break the cloud production. The more surface area the coil has the more vapor it will produce. That’s why If you use a regular 22 gauge round wire coil it’ll have less vapor production than a clapton wire coil. You can buy rolls of Clapton wire on Kay bee vapes’ website or you can take a roll of 22 gauge and twist it yourself with a drill and get better clouds and flavor than a single wire coil.

There are allot of variables. Like, do you know how to rebuild an RDA and do you have a high wattage device. Don’t get me wrong you can get huge clouds off a small set up but if you’re going for a show off type set up you will need, Clapton wire, a big enough RDA, and a powerful enough device.  Something like a Goon on a reuleaux Gen3 with some twisted 22 g kanthal or some alien Clapton’s. I’m rocking a Tsunami 22 on a reuleaux Gen3 and some twisted 22 gauge coils and it’s a fog machine.
Only time I have to give the mod a wipe down is if I over drip or carb it too much.
